Two platforms, one connected workflow

Better insight for stronger execution

MATA - Analytics

Transform data into trading intelligence

Turn cross-asset insight into actionable pre-trade intelligence, helping you evaluate executions decisions before you move.

  • Quantify expected execution costs before commitment
  • Compare strategies side by side to evaluate potential outcomes
  • Explore interactive outlier views to focus on higher-risk or harder-to-trade orders
  • Monitor market conditions and portfolio exposures
  • Model scenarios across asset classes
MAAS - Execution

Drive stronger performance outcomes

Turn trading insight into disciplined execution, with advanced technology designed to adapt as market conditions change.

  • Access adaptive algorithms built for live market conditions
  • Select AI-powered strategies tailored to execution objectives
  • Route orders intelligently to help minimize market impact
  • Support consistency across asset classes through shared execution logic, connected workflows and platform-wide controls
  • Benchmark performance against pre-trade expectations
  • Trade equities, futures, currencies and rates from a single execution framework

MATA capabilities

Sharper insight. Smarter trades.

Explore MATA capabilities across core asset classes, with specialized index intelligence for event-driven trading decisions.

Equities

Cash Equities, ETFs & ADRs

Evaluate how to execute before you move, with expected cost estimates, strategy comparisons, close analytics and interactive outlier views.

FX

G10 & EM Currency Pairs

Analyze real-time market liquidity conditions, assess expected execution costs across currency pairs, and monitor live order performance and benchmarks during execution.

Futures

Index, Commodity & Rate Futures

Track roll dynamics, historical roll volume and open interest progression, then use execution cost analysis and strategy optimization to evaluate approaches across futures.

Index events

120+ Global Indices

Anticipate index changes before rebalances with analytics shaped by RBC Capital Markets' Program Trading team, including expected additions, deletions, upweights and downweights, corporate action analysis, spread analytics and symbol-level share impact estimates.
